", "sha256": "c7b9e3dcbab0259ecaa5321e051809adee77bc229141cd07b163697e570670c1", "semantic_role": "source_paragraph"}, {"id": "id06722", "tag": "p", "text": "— Oui, Giulio, dit-elle, fière et heureuse, car j'ai trouvé le moyen d'étouffer cette hydre.", "source_html": "

", "sha256": "708d8cc8626a705df8d206aa766015204292bb2c958fce790cfdfcd76f5b89fd", "semantic_role": "source_paragraph"}, {"id": "id06730", "tag": "p", "text": "— Et quelle est cette troisième personne?", "source_html": "

", "sha256": "66e93a34791bb995752267d1e7e6617d8df2afd23d3fa08c1088072ab99e41f8", "semantic_role": "source_paragraph"}, {"id": "id06731", "tag": "p", "text": "— M. le Prince.", "source_html": "
